references.text: Doing what is right in the Lord's eyes is a recurring theme in Deuteronomy, emphasizing the importance of obedience to God's commands.
The same expression about doing what is right in the Lord's eyes, linked to obedience to his commands.
The call to keep all the Lord's commands and do what is good and right in his eyes.
The promise of blessing for listening to the voice of the Lord and keeping his commands.
The blessings that come from carefully listening to the voice of the Lord your God and keeping all his commands.
Listening to the voice of the Lord and keeping his commands written in the Book of the Law.
An early formulation of the principle of listening to the voice of the Lord and doing what is right in his eyes.
Samuel emphasizes that obeying the voice of the Lord is better than sacrifice, confirming the importance of obedience.
Jeremiah reminds the people of the covenant: listen to my voice, and I will be your God.
John confirms that loving God means keeping his commands, and that his commands are not burdensome.
